# TwoMoon Academy

> A fun, gamified platform to learn English, built for Indonesian students.

TwoMoon Academy offers a structured learning path (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) with vocabulary flashcards (spaced repetition), grammar, listening, speaking, and reading practice, quizzes with instant feedback, daily streaks, XP, achievements, and leaderboards.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of TwoMoon Academy and how it helps you learn English.
- [Learning path](/learn): Browse all lessons by level and category.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or log in.
